title: Comparing Floating-Point Results
description: An exact float comparison that can fail from rounding, and two tolerant forms that check closeness instead.

steps.description: This shows how to compare floating-point results. The page says the first form may fail because of floating-point rounding.
The `BAD` line compares `run("0.1 + 0.2")` to `0.3` exactly. The comment says it may fail due to floating-point rounding.
The `GOOD` form uses `math.isclose` with a relative tolerance of `1e-9`, which checks whether the two values are close rather than equal.
The last line uses `pytest.approx(0.3)`, which does the same tolerant comparison with pytest's own helper.
